overrides.reason: DGGEVX hands its LWORK to DGEQRF, DORMQR and DORGQR, which pick their block size from LWORK and fall back to unblocked code when it is short of the optimum. The blocked and unblocked QR steps round differently, and the QZ iteration that follows can then reach a generalized Schur form (S,T) whose rows and columns differ by signs, with eigenvectors scaled by -1 (real) or by a different complex unit (complex pairs); DTGSNA's DIF estimate (RCONDV), computed from that Schur form, moves with it. ALPHAR, ALPHAI, BETA and RCONDE do not depend on LWORK beyond rounding; the module's tests check them, and RCONDV within a factor 2, at the minimum WORK past the blocking threshold (ticket 0100).

set.params.A.workDependent: the generalized Schur form S is unique only up to signs, which the LWORK-dependent QR blocking can change
set.params.B.workDependent: the triangular T is unique only up to signs, which the LWORK-dependent QR blocking can change
set.params.VL.workDependent: each left eigenvector is unique only up to a scalar factor of unit size, which the LWORK-dependent QR blocking can change
set.params.VR.workDependent: each right eigenvector is unique only up to a scalar factor of unit size, which the LWORK-dependent QR blocking can change
set.params.RCONDV.workDependent: DTGSNA's DIF estimate is computed from the Schur form, whose signs the LWORK-dependent QR blocking can change
